notes: Written for this project. Every content word of the Latin matrix column, with its forms.

Nouns, adjectives and pronouns list each case in the singular and plural; adjectives list each gender. Features use meaning@1 ids: @nominative, @genitive, @dative, @accusative, @ablative and @vocative for case, @plural for number, and @masculine, @feminine and @neuter for gender (a noun's forms all carry its own gender). A form without @plural is singular. Personal pronouns carry their person (@first-person for ego), so a verb can agree.
Verbs list the present, imperfect (@past with @ongoing) and perfect (@past) in each person (@first-person, @second-person, @third-person, with @plural), the imperative (@command) and the infinitive.
Long vowels carry macrons, as in the matrix column.
